scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css shortcuts.json dist/ && cp -r schemas dist/ && glib-compile-schemas dist/schemas
scripts.install-local: npm run build && rm -rf ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/dory@mowerick.github.io && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/dory@mowerick.github.io && cp -r dist/. ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/dory@mowerick.github.io/
scripts.dev: npm run install-local && MUTTER_DEBUG_DUMMY_MODE_SPECS=1600x900 dbus-run-session --config-file=./dev/dbus-session.conf gnome-shell --devkit --wayland
